title: The Sea That Would Not Part
subtitle: Where faith is asked to walk before the water moves

intro.text: Past the wilderness the road runs into water. Not a river — a sea, black and loud, with no visible other side.
Look at it, Believer. I do not have to push you in. You simply have to agree that it is too wide.
Every sea that ever parted had one thing in common: someone stepped in while it was still water.
The third Power Verse is about that step. Restore it, and we will see what the water does.

levels.title: The Shore of No

dialogue.text: I've measured it twice. There's no ford. No shallow. Just… no.
Thomas is right, Believer. And being right about the obstacle is the most respectable way to never move.
Why does it get quieter when I say 'fear not' out loud? Listen — fear… not.
Because it is an instruction, not a feeling. Rebuild the reason it is given.

levels.mission: Rebuild the reason fear is refused.

puzzle.verse: Fear thou not; for I am with ____: be not dismayed; for I am thy ____.
hints: The first blank is an old word for 'you'.
The second blank names who is speaking.
puzzle.reveal: "Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God." — Isaiah 41:10

levels.title: The Moth and the Flame

dialogue.text: A moth keeps flying into our fire. Over and over. It never learns that the flame will take it.
Or it knows exactly what it is flying toward. Sara — which of these is the word our people actually live by?
Choose carefully, Believer. The wrong answer sounds very much like wisdom.
Pick the one you'd want carved on your forge door.

levels.mission: Choose the word the faithful actually walk in.

puzzle.prompt: "For God hath not given us the spirit of ____; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind."
hints: The verse lists three things you were given — the blank is the one you were NOT given.
It is the thing the Shadow has been whispering since the square.
puzzle.reveal: "For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind." — 2 Timothy 1:7

levels.title: The Wind on the Water
levels.setting: Night nine, the waves learn to spell

dialogue.text: On the ninth night the waves rise and write again — across, and down, crossing into each other.
The sea is older than your Book, Believer. It has drowned stronger faith than yours.
It has also carried a man asleep in its stern while the wind obeyed Him. Rebuild the lattice.
Crossing words! Thomas says those are the strong kind — like his forge joints!

levels.mission: Rebuild the lattice written by the waves.

clues.clue: "how is it that ye have no ____?"

hints: STILL is five letters and sits in the top row.
FAITH is the down answer that crosses three of them.
puzzle.reveal: "Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm." — Mark 4:39

levels.title: Torn by the Undertow
levels.setting: Night fourteen, the page goes under

dialogue.text: An undertow takes the page from your pack and shreds it against the rocks.
The pieces are on the sand. All of them. Salt-soaked, but all of them.
Reassemble it, then. Salt does not forgive mistakes.
Neither does it care how many attempts it takes. Put the promise back in its spoken order.

levels.mission: Rebuild the promise the undertow shredded.

puzzle.prompt: Arrange the promise as it was first spoken.
items: Be strong and of a good courage;
for the LORD thy God is with thee
correctOrder: Be strong and of a good courage;
for the LORD thy God is with thee
hints: Courage comes first, then the two things to refuse.
It ends with a reason, not a command.
puzzle.reveal: "Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee." — Joshua 1:9

levels.title: Dread Rides the Tide
levels.setting: Night twenty-one, the sea stands up

dialogue.text: On the twenty-first night the sea itself stands up. The Shadow rides the crest, ankle-deep in the storm.
Three verses recovered, Believer. Two left. And I have all the water in the world.
Peter walked. Peter also sank. Remember that the same man did both.
He sank reaching down, and rose reaching up. Believer — the words are drifting in the spray. Find them.
I'm not letting go of this rope. Whatever happens out there.
Shout them when you find them! It worked in the wilderness!

levels.mission: Hunt the words drifting in the spray.

hints: One of them is the word that stopped a storm.
puzzle.reveal: Still, calm, faith, courage, arise — the sea has no answer for any of them. The third Power Verse is restored.
